description: The Statistical Service of Cyprus publishes housing results of the Census of Population and Housing 2021 in its CYSTAT-DB PxWeb database. Three tables count conventional dwellings enumerated on 1 October 2021: by year of construction in nine periods from before 1919 to 2016-2021, occupied dwellings by construction period and tenure status, and dwellings by the type of building they sit in. Coverage is the five districts listed in the tables (Lefkosia, Ammochostos, Larnaka, Lemesos and Pafos), each split into urban and rural areas. In total 491,545 conventional dwellings were enumerated, of which 193,427 were detached houses, 66,404 semi-detached or duplex and 156,614 in apartment blocks. Companion folders hold population and household size and type tables. Format and access: free PxWeb tables, downloadable as CSV, XLSX or PX, and a PxWeb JSON API with no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: district level only, with no municipal or grid breakdown in these tables, and no water, energy or amenity variables. Simulation uses: building age and type mix for seismic and flood vulnerability and for energy retrofit modelling of the housing stock. Related records: the SSB Norway dwelling stock statistics.
